datedDelivery.summary: The Stage PH3 delivery records accessible Terms and Privacy dialogs with ordinary and modified native link behavior. The main branch retains its separately bounded PH2 footer and Google account-selection source changes.
datedDelivery.validation: Existing Stage receipts record focused browser, document, public HTTP and exact-asset checks. A full product suite was not rerun for this public update.

limits.scope: Stage PH3, Stage main and PROD remain separate evidence scopes. This snapshot changes no PROD authority or holds and proves neither human UAT, owner enrollment, full MCP interoperability nor hosted recovery.
